profile.headline: Assistant Vice President at Bank of America
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: Stevens Institute of Technology's Class of 2021 majoring in Business and Technology with concentrations in Computer Science and Information Systems. Proficient in Python and Java with experience in R, SQL, Javascript, HTML, and the Bloomberg Terminal. Check out my website: ericsang.com

positions.title: Global Credit Structured Products | Assistant Vice President | Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Implementing a brand new trading desk facing application BWIC Air, a Collateralized Loan Obligation (CLO) Bids Wanted In Competition (BWIC) lifecycle tracking system to replace a legacy Excel application.
• Integrating an Openfin (HERE Framework) React/JS UI with Bofa’s proprietary Quartz python backend.
• Building foundational tooling and reusable components to standardize the structure and development of future React applications across the team.
• Maintain communication with the desk to receive requirements to drive feature development.

positions.title: Global Credit Structured Products | Assistant Vice President | Risk Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
• Helped onboard our team’s Collateralized Debt Obligation risk analysis onto a new horizontal risk platform, built on the proprietary Quartz framework.
• Reverse-engineered legacy Excel VBA and C# code to inform architecture and implementation of the new system.
• Developed a data analysis framework to benchmark vector calculations from Intex and Bloomberg, measuring performance across varying data complexities and distributed compute configurations.

positions.title: Equity Risk Systems Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed, tested, and maintained systems for distributing option scenario calculations for all MS risk managers’ global portfolios.
• Deployed applications into both QA and production environments with various code reviews, change descriptions, and approvals.
• Collaborated with a distributed global team in NY and Budapest to coordinate broad development goals and releases.
• Worked with KDB Q, IBM MQ, AutoSys, and SQL and IBM Symphony, AWS S3, and AWS EC2 for distributed computing.
• Created a Python library to standardize transactions between various systems, such as AutoSys, Sybase, Symphony, and internal systems for application, credential, and management. Also standardized configurations and loggers across multiple apps for checking required paths and environment variables, simplified option defining, importing libraries with internal tools, and inheriting from other configs.
• Worked with global application support to handle production issues, on call from 9am to 1am for a week every month.
• Participated in daily Scrum meetings with additional bi-weekly sprint planning, backlog refinement for task management and work estimations, and sprint retrospective meetings.

positions.title: Technology Analyst Program (TAP)
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
• Participated in lectures, labs, and assessments with bi-weekly instructor review.
• Reviewed Unix, C, C++, C#, Java, Scala, Python, SQL, data structures, and design practices. 
• Completed a group project to create a basic equity trading system using Java, SQL, IBM MQ, and HTML. 
• Collaborated with other analysts to make a new system for an internal team which monitored the health of every core component of specific programs into a web-accessible dashboard.
• Presented and demoed projects to instructors and incoming teams.

positions.title: CS 110 TA
positions.description:
• Created lesson plans for lectures and recitations, from print to OOP
• Met weekly with professor Kevin Ryan for progress reports
• Graded assignments, quizzes, and exams
• Met with all students one-on-one to discuss their understanding of the material and how to improve their submitted code
• Reformatted students' final projects and sent them back to explain how a more experience programmer would code their ideas

positions.title: Learning Technology Assistant
positions.description:
• Provide technical support for technology in classrooms (projectors, wireless display solutions, microphones, etc.)
• Upgrade technology infrastructure in classrooms

SAL (Stevens Automation Loader) Bot
• Created SAL to be used by the Learning Technology Department
• Sends information (class schedules, lockbox codes, professor locations, etc.) to staffers upon request. 
• Manages calendar events for the Solstice wireless display technology used in conference and class rooms throughout the campus.

positions.title: Institutional Securities Application Developer Intern
positions.description:
• Interned in the Institutional Securities division in Technology for the Equity Risk Systems team.
• Created a REST API to check if our AWS instances for storage and computing grid were working as intended.
• Uploaded and deleted files in S3 buckets to check read/write capabilities using the AWS SDK for Python library (boto3).
• Submitted tasks and checked results to EC2 instances via Symphony (IBM product).
• Attended daily scrum meetings with team to report project status.
• Recieved a full-time offer as an Analyst in Morgan Stanley's Technology Division for August 2021.

positions.title: JP Morgan Chase Code for Good Hackathon
positions.description:
• Assigned to create a solution for Shatterproof, a national nonprofit dedicated to ending drug addiction
• Within 24 hours, created a website with a chatting application for victims and helpful information about drug abuse, rehab locations, etc.
• Implemented Agile and Scrum program solutions during the creation of the application

positions.title: Applications Developer Intern
positions.description:
• Continuation of last year's project of automating performance and attribution reports. 
• Reworking structure of the code to become less excel dependent and more "pythonic". 
• The new structure will allow for future compatibility of different exporting methods. 
• Optimizing code to cut down on run times, complexity, and readability. 
• Automating new reports to expand usability to more co-workers on the client relations side.

positions.title: AllianceBernstein - Bernstein University
positions.description:
• Participated in an AllianceBernstein event for interns working at their buy-side companies
• Toured the New York Stock Exchange to learn about how the NYSE operates and watched several IPOs. 
• Went to AllianceBernstein’s offices in midtown New York. 
• Listened to presentations that reviewed options trading, research, and fund management they do at their firm and toured their trading floor.

positions.title: Google Tech Challenge NYC
positions.description:
• Full day hackathon that was hosted by Google in their New York office.
• Hackathon was based on multiple coding challenges and problem sets.
• Each group was from different schools, our group placed 6th out of 29 teams.

positions.title: JP Morgan Chase Sophomore Edge Program
positions.description:
• A three-day conference in JP Morgan Chase's office in Chicago.
• The program gave exposure to the world of banking and the different career paths through a series of in-person events and virtual sessions.
• Went through the technology track of the program, learned about the current technology used at JPMC and systems they are working on.

positions.title: Applications Developer Intern
positions.description:
Quantitative Asset Manager offering multi-asset and equity strategies with $20+ billion under management with operations in New York and Boston.

• Created a Python program that generates client reports containing portfolio exposure, attribution, and performance data from Northern Trust and Factset for the Client Relations Team
• Leveraged various Python libraries such as Openpyxl and xlrd for Excel data manipulation and PyQt for the user interface
• Implemented Python pandas library to calculate the VIX 5-day moving average from daily historical data provided by CBOE's website
• Wrote technical and user documentation and provided training to IT and Client Relations Team
• Participated in equity, multi-asset, research, and technology department meetings as well as machine learning vendor meetings

positions.title: Web Developer/Server
positions.description:

• Updated BigCommerce website with custom scripts
• Integrated the Square POS system into the store
• Photographed and edited images of products for the websites
• Managed the front of the store
• Cooked food and assisted off-site catering events

projects.title: Stevens Course Scheduler Alternative
projects.description: I am creating a system to build upon the functionality of the Stevens Institute of Technology's student course scheduler. This program will be accessed via a website and will provide students an easy way to generate every possible combination of courses with optional filters and conditionals. These filters could range from time block omissions to professor ratings scraped from www.ratemyprofessors.com.

projects.title: Hurricane to Stock Regression Analysis
projects.description: This was a final project for my Financial Econometrics course. The topic chosen was to see if there was any correlation between company performance and hurricane paths. Python is being used with PyQt for GUI components, openpyxl for excel reading/writing, as well as other libraries for statistical analysis. Stocks were sorted by GICS sectors from the S&P 500 and historical data was retrieved from R's quantmod library. Hurricane data was collected from the Nation Hurricane Center's HURRDAT datasets. Factors such as hurricane coordinate paths, company market capitalization, and oil refinery locations are being analyzed.
